description: [PAID $1.00 USDC per call via x402] For a deal recorded by the LogicNodes deal notary: verifies the signed, hash-chained record and gives an ADVISORY ruling from fixed rules (R0, R1, R2, R3, R4, R5, R6: settled, delivered and checked, failed check, uncheckable, never delivered, never agreed). Returns the facts it used (with event hashes), the rule applied, and a ruling digest that goes into the Bitcoin-timestamped daily root. Advisory only: not a legal judgment and not enforced.
name: deal_dispute_review
title: Advisory ruling on a notarized deal (dispute review)
